from: June book, night 25 (No Hammer Was Heard)
p1: King Solomon built a temple, a house for the Lord. It would be a holy place, so it was built with care.
The big stones were cut and made ready somewhere else first. Then they were carried to the temple, ready to set in place.
So no one heard a hammer, an axe, or any iron tool there. The Lord’s house grew up quietly, stone by stone.
p2: Inside, Solomon covered the walls with pure gold. He carved palm trees and open flowers. It took seven years to finish the Lord’s house! Today there are temples all over the world, holy houses of the Lord.
Tonight, be very still for a moment, like the quiet temple. Someday you can go to the Lord’s house too.
old: King Solomon wanted to build a beautiful temple for Heavenly Father. He gathered the BEST materials — strong cedar wood, smooth stones, and shining gold!
Thousands of workers helped. They cut the stones perfectly far away. When they put the stones together at the temple, no one heard a hammer or chisel! It was so quiet and holy.
The temple took SEVEN whole years to build! Inside, everything was covered in gold. There were carvings of angels and flowers everywhere. It was the most beautiful place ever!
The temple was a special place where people could feel close to Heavenly Father. Solomon wanted to give Heavenly Father his very best. We can give Heavenly Father our best too!
